Not much later, the sight of the formation could be seen turning to meet the flight path of the presidents jet. The grey painted stealth fighters flew alongside their Oceanice counterparts, rocked their wings, and took their place once the others pulled off and headed back to Oceanice. 

The rest of the flight would be uneventful. An occasional island would be along the flightpath, giving something to look at other than the vast ocean. The escorts would be replaced a little past halfway in, something about adequate fuel if needed. Finally, the formation began to descend, signaling its approach to New Rorack Airport. The other air traffic has been diverted to other nearby airports for today, so there shouldn't be any complications.

Touching down in the large airport, it's easy to see the area set up for the event even while landing at speed. Slowly, the jet taxied to the reception area, and finally, the international show will begin. Departing the jet, Willham and his entourage would be met by crowds of reporters and news crews, all being kept behind the barriers by Military police. To complete the ensemble, President Achebe is waiting just past the mobile staircase with his own small group of representatives.

Welcome friend! I trust you didnt run into any issues getting here? President Achebe says, walking beside President Willham down the temporary isle to where a convoy of official vehicles sat.[/quote]
